title: A Thousand Mountains | Pale Blue
subtitle: The original song is “Deep Blue.” Its lyrics and melody are beautiful. With my meager talent and learning, I wrote new lyrics anyway. Happy birthday!
body:
After saying goodnight, I turn off the screen My pale-blue mood Reluctant to let go, looking back again and again Telling myself it is nothing
Your faint smile is like a roaming dragon I am bewildered as a puppet You lick your lips without thinking The puppet gains a heartbeat
Come close to you, warm you, embrace you With my pale-blue gaze Watch you, surround you, enter you This is my silent desire
I still remember the snowy mountains you photographed for me Imagining myself as the little figure on skis A veiled but heartfelt joke
Blue mist gathers all around Only in dreams Have I hypnotized you into flirting with me How happy, how humble
Your faint smile is like a roaming dragon I am bewildered as a puppet You lick your lips without thinking The puppet gains a heartbeat
Come close to you, warm you, embrace you With my pale-blue gaze Watch you, surround you, enter you This is my silent desire
Space and time overlap in our starry sky The allusions in our names, under quantum entanglement Fill the cracks with a sense of destiny
Give you the utter devotion of the moonlight of old Not the forgetting of a spring-wind poet’s pen Let that hidden fragrance delight in me alone[1] --- [1] The final stanza draws on the imagery and wording of Jiang Kui’s ci poem [*An Xiang*](https://www.shidianguji.com/book/SBCK231/chapter/1j741jxm5v6lh_183) (暗香, “Hidden Fragrance”), including the moonlight of old and the poet’s spring-wind pen.
